newsitem.title: CHINA: HK-based TV station says China's Deng is dead.
newsitem.headline: HK-based TV station says China's Deng is dead.

text.p: The Hong Kong-based television station Chinese Television Network reported on Wednesday that Chinese paramount leader Deng Xiaoping had died, station officials said by telephone.
"According to latest news from Beijing, our station has reported that China's veteran Deng Xiaoping died at around 9.00 p.m. (1300 GMT) today," a station official said.
She declined to give further details.
Rumours have been circulating throughout Beijing for several days that the 92-year-old Deng is critically ill.
